boundsPortedFromTheOracle.openCircuit: src/state.js: t.totalGas = t.volume * t.pressure, and resetDive() refills gasRemaining = totalGas. drawPostDive() (src/renderer.js) shows totalGas - gasRemaining per cylinder.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.rebreather: resetDive() snapshots ccrState.o2CylPressureStart and dilCylPressureStart; drawPostDive() shows (start - current) * volume for O2 and diluent, and scrubberTotal - scrubberRemaining.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.model: TankState.startGasL; CcrState.oxygenCylinderStartPressureBar, diluentCylinderStartPressureBar, scrubberTotalS. createTankState and createCcrState default them to the configured fill; nothing in the dive changes them.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.dive: The model draws gas and runs the scrubber down only in a step that adds that step's time to elapsedTimeS (legacy: diveTime += before scrubberRemaining -= in the same tick), so the scrubber is never used for longer than the dive, and at elapsed time 0 nothing has been drawn.
